description:
List global change events

Every typed change event, newest-first, cursor-paginated. Any anomaly an event triggered is embedded on it. `cursor` walks older events; `prev_cursor` walks the newer edge (for live polling). The first page carries a `meta` block with exact type facets + filter count and an auto-bucketed timeline chart.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as `next_cursor` by the previous page.

doctype.description: Filter to events touching one document-type URN. Matches both payload shapes: the merged `endpoint_changed` `doctypes` array and the legacy singular `doctype` on pre-merge rows.

host.description: Filter to events for one host.

limit.description: Page size, clamped to [1, 200]. Defaults to 50.

prev_cursor.description: Opaque newer-direction cursor (from a page's `prev_cursor`): returns events newer than it, newest-first. Mutually exclusive with `cursor`.

seat.description: Filter to events referencing one seat.

since.description: Only include items at or after this ISO 8601 instant.

type.description: Comma-array of change-event types (a single value is valid).

until.description: Only include events at or before this ISO 8601 instant.

name: list_events
